verdict.rationale: There is no explicit batch endpoint or multi-file CLI command in the evidence; the CLI example converts a single document. Bulk processing is only implied by three things: async jobs with webhooks that avoid polling, reusable pipelines and stored files usable across many API calls, and Team-plan rate limits of 400 req/min. missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk API or SDK method, multi-file or directory CLI conversion, bulk job status management, and hands-on corroboration of high-volume processing.
